competences.description: With an attack that always lands as a Critical Hit, removes 1 beneficial effect from the enemy with a 75% chance and stuns the enemy for 1 turn with a 15% chance. The damage increases according to your MAX HP.

effets.description: Removes one or more beneficial effects from target monster(s)
The target will be stunned and won't be able to attack.
Attack will always land as a Critical Hit

competences.description: Defends the ally target for 3 turns and instantly recovers your turn. Receives half of the damage inflicted on the defended target while making the damage dealt to the defended target to 0 and counterattacks the enemy target.

effets.description: The caster of this skill will receive half of the damage inflicted on the escorted target while making the damage dealt to the defended target to 0 and counterattack the enemy target.
When attacked, the target will counterattack to inflict 75% of the Attack Power as damage.

competences.description: Attacks all enemies with a spell that summons the power of water to decrease their Attack Speed for 2 turns with an 80% chance and increases the Attack Bar of all allies by 25%. The damage is proportionate to your MAX HP.

effets.description: The target's Attack Speed will be decreased by 30%.
The ATK bar of ally monsters is filled by a set amount. This allows ally monsters to attack again sooner.
